reason: The official HM Land Registry lookup page confirms a current August 2026 CSV distribution containing Transaction unique identifier and INSPIRE ID fields, released under OGL v3.0 and updated 29 September 2026. The CSV endpoint is public/no-login but returns an unsupported text/csv payload through the current transport, so no concrete lookup row, INSPIRE ID, canonical_parcel_id, or parcel geometry is asserted. Moreover the lookup table links identifiers but does not itself supply geometry. Spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
